business_summary: Beijing JingPinTeZhuang Science and Technology Co.,LTD. engages in the research, development, production, and sale of optoelectronic reconnaissance equipment and military robot systems primarily in China. The company provides special robots, such as bomb disposal, reconnaissance, nuclear and chemical inspection, accompanying and assisting, lawn mowing, pipeline, and combat robots, as well as upstream robot components/assemblies, subsystems, motors, and other products. It also offers intelligent detection and sensing products, such as fusion telescopes, handheld integrated observation instruments, wall-penetrating radar, multi-functional night vision glasses, AR night vision glasses, sound detection equipment, and high-intensity light denial devices, as well as aircraft/vehicle-mounted supporting equipment comprising intelligent pods, positioning and navigation systems, target guidance equipment, and radar and communication products. In addition, the company provides intelligent tightening equipment and material conveying equipment; and warehouse control system, including warehouse robots, autonomous conveyors, and stacker cranes. Further, it offers simulation technology system comprising digital defense education product solutions; and construction and operation solutions for defense education bases, exhibition halls, etc. Additionally, it engages in manufacturing of public safety equipment and materials, electrical signal equipment and devices, and electric toys; maintenance of general equipment; software development; sales of civil aircraft, fire-fighting equipment, electronic products, computer software, public safety equipment, and metal signs and facilities for traffic management; product design; contract manufacturing; project investment; import and export of goods and technology; scientific research and technical services; information transmission; and other cultural and artistic activities. The company was founded in 2009 and is based in Beijing, China.
business_summary_ko: 베이징 JingPinTeZhuang Science and Technology Co.,LTD. 주로 중국에서 광전자 정찰 장비 및 군사 로봇 시스템의 연구, 개발, 생산 및 판매에 종사하고 있습니다. 이 회사는 폭탄 처리, 정찰, 핵 및 화학 검사, 동행 및 지원, 잔디 깎기, 파이프라인 및 전투 로봇과 같은 특수 로봇뿐만 아니라 업스트림 로봇 구성 요소/조립품, 하위 시스템, 모터 및 기타 제품을 제공합니다. 또한 융합 망원경, 휴대용 통합 관측 기기, 벽 관통 레이더, 다기능 야간 투시경, AR 야간 투시경, 소리 감지 장비, 고강도 광 거부 장치 등 지능형 탐지 및 감지 제품은 물론 지능형 포드, 위치 확인 및 항법 시스템, 표적 유도 장비, 레이더 및 통신 제품으로 구성된 항공기/차량 탑재 지원 장비도 제공합니다. 또한 회사는 지능형 조임 장비 및 재료 운반 장비를 제공합니다. 창고 로봇, 자율 컨베이어, 스태커 크레인을 포함한 창고 제어 시스템. 또한 시뮬레이션 기술 시스템 구성 요소를 제공합니다.
